slides.title:
One intent. Different computers.
Traceable results.
slides.subtitle: A synthetic 12-guest wedding becomes a complete, inspectable activity.

slides.title:
The computation changed.
The commitment did not.
slides.subtitle: A request, its conditions and its current owner remain connected to the result.

slides.title:
A familiar optimization problem
becomes an operating-system case study.
slides.subtitle: The contribution is how a changing activity stays connected around its solver.

slides.title:
Nineteen real model calls shaped
seven recorded episodes.
slides.subtitle: One model: Gemini 2.5 Flash. Two roles: intent orchestrator and requirement architect.

slides.title:
A different wish selected a different
objective and a different local plan.
slides.subtitle: The model chose between two declared profiles; the solver produced the arrangement.

slides.title:
A changed request created a new
condition, with its predecessor intact.
slides.subtitle: Guests 07 and 08 move together: table 2 → table 1 → verify without another search.

slides.title:
“Check this plan” performed less work
than “make a plan”.
slides.subtitle: A finite capability catalogue turns semantic differences into different execution paths.

slides.title:
Budget and memory affected
real work in the local precursor.
slides.subtitle: Recorded W2 evidence: useful diagnostics and a scoped LocalDRS return path.

slides.title:
The numerical adapter changed
while the original conditions stayed.
slides.subtitle: A documented engineering change from an annealing-oriented plan to gate-based hardware.

slides.title:
An exact reduction preserved
every feasible seating assignment.
slides.subtitle: Classical mathematics and preparation remained explicit around the QPU.

slides.title:
Two real tasks returned measurements
from the same Rigetti QPU.
slides.subtitle: Amazon Braket · Rigetti Cepheus-1-108Q · recorded 24 September 2026.

slides.title:
Every shot was checked against
the original seating conditions.
slides.subtitle: Feasible samples were a small subset; their selected plans still matched the finite optimum.

slides.title:
A saved plan can be traced
to one specific hardware measurement.
slides.subtitle: No failed sample was replaced by a classical solution.

slides.title:
Waiting preserved task identity
without extending old authority.
slides.subtitle: Submission and later result consumption remained separate, bounded decisions.

slides.title:
Each participant received a different
projection of the same activity.
slides.subtitle: Disclosure controls protected selected synthetic fields, with explicit trust assumptions.

slides.title:
A measured candidate could fail
even when its decoding was coherent.
slides.subtitle: The original domain rules decided admissibility before acceptance.

slides.title:
The recorded result can be checked
without buying another QPU task.
slides.subtitle: An external pin binds the accepted portable bytes; installed code checks supported relations.

slides.title:
The comparison concerns evaluated
scope, not a solver leaderboard.
slides.subtitle: Related work already formulates seating, exchanges optimizers and checks feasibility.

slides.title:
A 107-guest profile needs new domain
engineering, not a new owner principle.
slides.subtitle: Architectural extension argument. The observed experiment remains 12 guests.

slides.title:
Inspect the words. Trace the sample.
Verify the result.
slides.subtitle: The computation changed. The commitment did not.

claims.english_headline: A person asks for a result, not a cloud workflow.

claims.rendered_value: Intent → finite semantic catalogue → performed work → checked result.

claims.english_headline: The requested objective changes the accepted seating.
claims.observed_value: KEEP_FAMILIAR_V01 and MIX_CIRCLES_V01 select distinct local W3 plans.
claims.caveat_assumption: Two predefined objective profiles share the same mandatory conditions. W4 hardware plans are separate outputs.
claims.rendered_value: KEEP_FAMILIAR_V01 and MIX_CIRCLES_V01 select distinct local W3 plans.

claims.rendered_value: GENERATE: review,compile,solve,validate,consume. VERIFY/SR3: validate,consume; search/QUBO/encoding counts0.
